notes.title: Demo 1.1 is here!
notes.content: [p]An update on the demo has been released with the following features:[/p][p]-Boss fight mechanic: at the end of the night, fight against a fierce boss that will put your skills to the test[/p][p]-Visual polish: a few effects have been added to some enemies[/p][p]-General balance changes[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, a video with the gameplay is available: [/p][previewyoutube="fyxddZX6zPk;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Live Now!
notes.content:
Hello! 
A playtest will be live from today to give players a look into the game, help report bugs, and give feedback in preparation for officially launching the demo on May 22nd.

Please feel free to leave any comments or use the form launched directly from the game, I'll gladly look into them.

These will help shape the game into an experience you will enjoy

Sincerely, Noxet Games Dev
